sections.content: You know *ya* and *todavía no* from Unit 2. Combine them with the *pretérito perfecto* while talking about a day out, using the same forms to describe what has happened during the outing.

items.english: We have already explored the market.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos descansado en la terraza.
items.english: We have not rested on the terrace yet.
We have already seen the region.

sections.content: Not every sentence needs *ya* or *todavía no* — *Hemos recordado la mañana* works perfectly with no marker at all. Add one only when the timing (already done vs. still pending) is actually part of what you want to say.
